This is a rough visual estimate. The plates are nearly empty, with only sauce stains and small residue left, so I assumed about 90% of the food was eaten. The pre-meal food (sliced beef, baby potatoes, lo mein, brownie, and juice) totals roughly 900 kcal and 600 g, and I scaled that down accordingly. Water is excluded.
